commit_policy: Keep this corrective separation slice local until both project workspaces and product-firewall validation pass. Preserve every pre-existing dirty path.

instruction_surfaces.change_reason: Route Morphovision and Spatial VR Strobe as separate project authorities and products.
Document Strobe product identity and removal of ambient activation authority.
Apply existing repo-family routing and public/private project boundaries.
Apply existing authority, activation, isolation, and validation contracts.
Use pre/post repository and dependency graph reconciliation.

non_scope: Implementing the dynamic Morphovision projection guard band in this corrective unit.
Changing Strobe visual, temporal, palette, deformation, or safety behavior beyond product selection.
Installing, launching, or mutating either Quest headset.
Moving or deleting existing uncommitted Strobe or Morphovision source.
objective: Separate the Spatial VR Strobe application from Rusty Symmetric Morphovision across workflow authority, build identity, runtime activation, properties, outputs, and agent routing without losing the current uncommitted work of either project.
outputs: Dedicated Morphovision and Spatial VR Strobe project workspaces.
A build-time product firewall that makes ambient Strobe properties powerless in Morphovision.
A durable project-isolation audit and routing documentation.
